page: Microsoft Azure M416s_9_v2 is a high-density, memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on Microsoft Hyper-V. Designed for enterprise-scale in-memory computing, the instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8280L processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. The hardware architecture features 208 physical cores and 416 vCPUs, backed by 8568.0 GB of system RAM, providing approximately 20.6 GB of memory per core. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 38 MB L3 cache per socket, with native support for AVX-512 vector extensions, VNNI, and hardware AES acceleration. Local ephemeral capacity includes a bundled 4398 GB solid-state drive.

Benchmark results highlight extreme multi-threaded throughput and memory bus bandwidth alongside modest single-core performance. The instance achieved top-tier marks in multi-threaded execution, demonstrating 376,152.0 on stress-ng multi-core testing, a PassMark CPU score of 117,679.0, and 1,376.63 GB/sec during multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. In-memory data structures benefit from exceptional bandwidth, recording 746.92 GB/sec in large-block uncached read tests and 353.37 million Redis SET operations per second. Conversely, per-core metrics show single-core stress-ng (1,366.59) and Geekbench single-core (1,119.0) placing in the lower quartile, reflecting the modest base clock speed of the Cascade Lake architecture.

The qualitative trade-off of the M416s_9_v2 centers on immense memory density and parallel processing scale rather than individual core velocity or specialized accelerator hardware. Lacking dedicated GPUs, it relies exclusively on its massive 416-thread capacity and vector instructions for computational tasks. This architectural profile makes the instance suitable for ultra-large SAP HANA deployments, massive relational or distributed in-memory databases, real-time analytics on massive transactional datasets, and memory-bound enterprise resource planning workloads.

It is driven by Intel Xeon Platinum 8280L processors operating at 2.7 GHz across 208 physical cores and 416 vCPUs. The instance pairs this massive compute capacity with 8568.0 GB of system memory, delivering roughly 20.6 GB of RAM per core, along with 4398 GB of local SSD storage. Benchmark telemetry reveals top-tier multi-threaded scalability and memory throughput, producing 353.37 million Redis SET operations per second and 746.92 GB/sec in uncached read bandwidth, while exhibiting comparatively lower single-core execution speed. Lacking discrete GPUs, the instance trades per-thread performance for extreme concurrent memory capacity, making it well matched for SAP HANA deployments, comprehensive in-memory analytics engines, and vast transactional database systems.
